business_question: What is the employee headcount and average annual compensation across departments?
sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.id) AS headcount, ROUND(AVG(s.annual_salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.department_id JOIN salaries s ON e.id = s.employee_id WHERE e.is_active = true GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY headcount DESC;

analysis.summary: Software Engineering is the largest department with 142 full-time employees, while Product & Design commands the highest average compensation at ₹19,20,000.
key_findings: Software Engineering represents 33.7% of total active company workforce.
Product & Design has the highest average annual compensation at ₹19,20,000, followed closely by Software Engineering at ₹18,50,000.
Customer Support and Operations maintain the lowest average compensation bands (₹6,80,000 and ₹8,50,000 respectively).
Total active workforce analyzed across all 6 departments stands at 421 employees.
recommendations: Benchmark Customer Support compensation against industry quartiles to curb attrition risk.
Plan specialized technical leadership retention programs for Product & Design and Engineering.
Model projected payroll impact for proposed Q3 headcount expansion in Sales.
data_quality_and_limitations: Only active, full-time payroll employees are reflected; contractors and interns are excluded.
Annual salary values reflect base compensation excluding performance equity and discretionary bonuses.
